# Inspection Reference

Every inspection the server registers, with the diagnostic codes it reports.
Configure them in `.config/shopware/lsp.yaml` (see the
[reference](reference.md)): `diagnostics.inspections.<id>` switches an
inspection, `diagnostics.rules.<code>` sets a code's severity. Suppress a code
on one line with an `@noinspection <code>` comment. Agents get the same
explanations from the MCP tool `shopware_explain_diagnostic`.

<!-- Generated by crates/app/src/tests/inspection_reference_test.rs from the
inspection registry; edit the inspection definitions, then regenerate with
SHOPWARE_LSP_UPDATE_REFERENCE=1 cargo test -p swlsp-app inspection_reference -->

## `php.imports`

Reports `use` imports nothing in the file refers to.

Languages: php. Domain: `php`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `php.unusedImport` | hint | yes |

**`php.unusedImport`**

- Fix: Remove the import; a quick fix removes that item, and the Organize Imports source action cleans up the whole file.
- Exceptions: A name used only in a doc comment counts as used. Files with a syntax error are not checked.

## `php.semantic`

Core PHP checks: undefined symbols, wrong argument counts and types, return types, visibility, inheritance and abstract-member rules, duplicate declarations, deprecations, and features or extensions the configured PHP version lacks.

Languages: php. Domain: `php`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `php.abstract` | warning | yes |
| `php.arguments` | warning | yes |
| `php.deprecated` | warning | yes |
| `php.duplicate` | warning | yes |
| `php.extension` | warning | yes |
| `php.inheritance` | warning | yes |
| `php.override` | warning | yes |
| `php.parse` | warning | yes |
| `php.returnType` | warning | yes |
| `php.undefined` | warning | yes |
| `php.version` | warning | yes |
| `php.visibility` | warning | yes |

**`php.abstract`**

- Fix: Implement the method the message names, or declare the class abstract.
- Exceptions: Abstract classes, interfaces and traits are not checked; a method inherited from a parent or a trait counts.

**`php.arguments`**

- Fix: Pass the arguments the signature in the message expects: the detail after the colon names the parameter and the type given.
- Exceptions: Arguments of unknown or mixed type match anything. Extra positional arguments to a function declared in the project are accepted, as PHP does. Calls with a spread of unknown shape, first-class callables and dynamic callees are not checked.

**`php.deprecated`**

- Fix: Use the replacement the message or the declaration's @deprecated note names.
- Exceptions: Uses inside a declaration that is itself deprecated, and inside the deprecated class itself, are not reported.

**`php.duplicate`**

- Fix: Keep one declaration of the class: rename or remove the other, or correct the namespace so it matches the file's PSR-4 path.

**`php.extension`**

- Fix: If the runtime has the extension, add it to php.extensions (or remove it from php.disabledExtensions) in .config/shopware/lsp.yaml; otherwise stop using the symbol.
- Exceptions: Reported only for an extension the project explicitly lacks; an extension whose availability is unknown is not reported.

**`php.inheritance`**

- Fix: Do not extend the class: use composition, or decorate its service. A class marked @final in its PHPDoc is not meant to be extended and may become final.

**`php.override`**

- Fix: Make the member compatible with the one it overrides: same static-ness, no narrower visibility, compatible parameter and return types. For a method marked #[Override] that overrides nothing, correct its name or remove the attribute.
- Exceptions: Constructors, private parent members and interfaces are not checked. With #[\ReturnTypeWillChange] the return type is not compared.

**`php.parse`**

- Fix: Correct the syntax at the reported position; the message names what the parser expected.

**`php.returnType`**

- Fix: Return a value of the declared type, or change the declared return type.
- Exceptions: Generators are not checked, nor are values of unknown or mixed type or declared types with unresolved templates.

**`php.undefined`**

- Fix: Correct the name, import the class with a use statement, or declare the member. For a class of an optional package, guard the use with class_exists().
- Exceptions: Functions and constants are never reported. Not reported: members on a receiver of unknown type, on classes with a matching magic method (__call, __get, ...), on stdClass and #[AllowDynamicProperties] classes, and static:: on a class that is not final.
- Opt out: Guard an optional class with class_exists(), interface_exists(), trait_exists() or enum_exists(), and an optional method with method_exists(); guarded uses are not reported.

**`php.version`**

- Fix: Use syntax the configured PHP version supports, or raise the version: it comes from config.platform.php or the php requirement in composer.json.

**`php.visibility`**

- Fix: Use a public method or accessor of the class, or widen the member's visibility if the class is yours.
- Exceptions: Not reported for classes with a matching magic method, and for Closure::bind scopes.

## `scss.variable`

Reports SCSS variables that are neither defined in the workspace nor provided by Shopware themes.

Languages: scss. Domain: `scss`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `scss.variable.unknown` | error | yes |

**`scss.variable.unknown`**

- Fix: Define the variable, or correct its name to one the workspace or a Shopware theme provides. A variable of a theme field must be declared in the theme's theme.json.
- Exceptions: Module variables (math.$pi) and named arguments are not checked. A variable bound anywhere in the file (a parameter, a loop variable) counts as defined. Nothing is reported until indexing has finished.

## `shopware.admin.block_override`

Administration template block overrides that are nested, conditional or repeated, and conditional or repeated parent calls.

Languages: javascript, twig, vue. Domain: `administration`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `admin.block-override.conditional` | error | yes |
| `admin.block-override.nested` | error | yes |
| `admin.block-override.repeated` | error | yes |
| `admin.block-parent.conditional` | error | yes |
| `admin.block-parent.repeated` | error | yes |

**`admin.block-override.conditional`**

- Fix: Declare the override unconditionally and put the v-if (or {% if %}) inside it, around the content.
- Exceptions: v-show does not count as a condition.

**`admin.block-override.nested`**

- Fix: Move the inner <sw-block extends> out of the outer one; each override is declared on its own, at the top level of the template.
- Exceptions: <sw-block> without extends is a new block, not an override, and may be nested.

**`admin.block-override.repeated`**

- Fix: Declare the override once and put the v-for (or {% for %}) inside it.

**`admin.block-parent.conditional`**

- Fix: Render <sw-block-parent> unconditionally; to hide the parent content conditionally wrap it in an element with the condition inside the override.

**`admin.block-parent.repeated`**

- Fix: Render <sw-block-parent> once, outside the loop.

## `shopware.admin.component`

Administration templates and scripts using components, CMS blocks and elements, directives or filters that are not registered, extending unregistered components, or using deprecated components and blocks.

Languages: javascript, twig, vue. Domain: `administration`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `admin.cms-block.not-found` | warning | yes |
| `admin.cms-element.not-found` | warning | yes |
| `admin.component.block-not-found` | warning | yes |
| `admin.component.deprecated` | hint | yes |
| `admin.component.deprecated-block` | hint | yes |
| `admin.component.not-found` | warning | yes |
| `admin.component.parent-not-found` | warning | yes |
| `admin.component.registry-not-found` | warning | yes |
| `admin.directive.not-found` | warning | yes |
| `admin.filter.not-found` | warning | yes |

**`admin.cms-block.not-found`**

- Fix: Use the name of a CMS block registered with registerCmsBlock(); a quick fix offers close names.
- Exceptions: The name property of a register call declares a block and is not checked.

**`admin.cms-element.not-found`**

- Fix: Use the name of a CMS element registered with registerCmsElement(); a quick fix offers close names.
- Exceptions: The name property of a register call declares an element and is not checked.

**`admin.component.block-not-found`**

- Fix: Correct the block name to one the parent component's template defines; a quick fix offers the close name.
- Exceptions: Reported only for a block name close to a parent block: a template of an extended or overridden component may define blocks of its own.

**`admin.component.deprecated`**

- Fix: Use the replacement the deprecation note names.
- Exceptions: From Shopware 6.7 the components replaced by Meteor are reported by admin.twig.migration.* instead.

**`admin.component.deprecated-block`**

- Fix: Override the block the deprecation note names instead.

**`admin.component.not-found`**

- Fix: Use the name of a registered component; a quick fix offers close names. A component of the extension itself must be registered with Component.register() and imported from the module's entry file.
- Exceptions: Only sw- and mt- tags are checked. Nothing is reported while the component index is empty.

**`admin.component.parent-not-found`**

- Fix: Pass the name of a registered component as the second argument of Component.extend().

**`admin.component.registry-not-found`**

- Fix: Use the name of a registered component; a quick fix offers close names.
- Exceptions: Nothing is reported while the component index is empty.
- Opt out: Guard an optional component with getComponentRegistry().has('name'); has() is not checked.

**`admin.directive.not-found`**

- Fix: Correct the directive name; a quick fix offers the close registered name.
- Exceptions: Reported only when a registered name is close to the one written; a name with no close match is taken for one added at runtime.

**`admin.filter.not-found`**

- Fix: Use the name of a registered filter; a quick fix offers close names.
- Exceptions: Only Filter.getByName() calls are checked.

## `shopware.admin.component_api`

Administration component usages passing unknown, missing, deprecated or mistyped props, listening to unknown events, or using unknown slots, slot props and models.

Languages: javascript, twig, vue. Domain: `administration`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `admin.component.bound-prop-type` | warning | yes |
| `admin.component.deprecated-prop` | hint | yes |
| `admin.component.invalid-prop-value` | warning | yes |
| `admin.component.missing-required-prop` | warning | yes |
| `admin.component.model-not-assignable` | warning | yes |
| `admin.component.model-type` | warning | yes |
| `admin.component.static-prop-type` | warning | yes |
| `admin.component.unknown-event` | warning | yes |
| `admin.component.unknown-model` | warning | yes |
| `admin.component.unknown-prop` | warning | yes |
| `admin.component.unknown-slot` | warning | yes |
| `admin.component.unknown-slot-prop` | warning | yes |

**`admin.component.bound-prop-type`**

- Fix: Pass a value of the type the prop expects.
- Exceptions: Only mismatches between whole categories are reported (a string for an Array prop); nullable values and expressions of unknown type are not.

**`admin.component.deprecated-prop`**

- Fix: Use the prop the deprecation note names.

**`admin.component.invalid-prop-value`**

- Fix: Use one of the values the prop accepts; a quick fix offers close ones.
- Exceptions: Only literal values of props with a closed set of values are checked.

**`admin.component.missing-required-prop`**

- Fix: Pass the prop; a quick fix adds the attribute with a placeholder value.
- Exceptions: Not reported when the prop arrives through v-model, or when the tag has a v-bind object that cannot be read statically.

**`admin.component.model-not-assignable`**

- Fix: Bind v-model to something that can be assigned: a data property or a writable computed property, not a literal or a call.

**`admin.component.model-type`**

- Fix: Bind a value of the type the component's model expects.
- Exceptions: Not reported when the type of the expression is unknown.

**`admin.component.static-prop-type`**

- Fix: Bind the value so it is read as an expression: write :prop="...". A quick fix adds the colon.
- Exceptions: String props, and boolean attributes without a value, are not reported.

**`admin.component.unknown-event`**

- Fix: Correct the event name; a quick fix offers the close name.
- Exceptions: Reported only for a name close to a declared event. Native DOM events are not checked.

**`admin.component.unknown-model`**

- Fix: Correct the v-model argument; a quick fix offers the close name.
- Exceptions: Reported only for a name close to a declared model.

**`admin.component.unknown-prop`**

- Fix: Correct the prop name; a quick fix offers the close name.
- Exceptions: Reported only for a name close to a declared prop. HTML attributes, data-* and aria-* fall through to the root element and are not checked.

**`admin.component.unknown-slot`**

- Fix: Correct the slot name; a quick fix offers the close name.
- Exceptions: Reported only for a name close to a declared slot. Dynamic slot families such as column-* are accepted.

**`admin.component.unknown-slot-prop`**

- Fix: Use a prop the slot exposes; a quick fix offers close names.
- Exceptions: Not reported when the slot's props are not fully known, or when the whole scope object is bound to one variable.

## `shopware.admin.member`

Administration code accessing members a component, the application container, the Shopware context or Shopware utils do not have, deprecated members, and event-bus events with missing or mistyped payloads and handlers.

Languages: javascript, twig, vue. Domain: `administration`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `admin.application-container.unknown-member` | warning | yes |
| `admin.component.deprecated-member` | hint | yes |
| `admin.component.unknown-instance-member` | warning | yes |
| `admin.component.unknown-template-member` | warning | yes |
| `admin.component.unknown-vue-member` | warning | yes |
| `admin.event-bus.handler-type` | warning | yes |
| `admin.event-bus.missing-handler` | warning | yes |
| `admin.event-bus.missing-payload` | warning | yes |
| `admin.event-bus.payload-type` | warning | yes |
| `admin.shopware-context.unknown-member` | warning | yes |
| `admin.shopware-utils.unknown-member` | warning | yes |

**`admin.application-container.unknown-member`**

- Fix: Correct the service or factory name; a quick fix offers the close name.
- Exceptions: Reported only when a registered name is close to the one written; a name with no close match is taken for one added at runtime.

**`admin.component.deprecated-member`**

- Fix: Use the member the deprecation note names.

**`admin.component.unknown-instance-member`**

- Fix: Declare the member on the component (data, props, computed, methods, inject), or correct its name; a quick fix offers close names.
- Exceptions: Names starting with $ are not checked, nor are components whose members cannot be listed completely (object spreads, mixins that cannot be resolved).

**`admin.component.unknown-template-member`**

- Fix: Correct the name to a member of the component; a quick fix offers the close name.
- Exceptions: Reported only when a registered name is close to the one written; a name with no close match is taken for one added at runtime.

**`admin.component.unknown-vue-member`**

- Fix: Use a property the value has; a quick fix offers close names.
- Exceptions: Not reported when the type of the value is not fully known.

**`admin.event-bus.handler-type`**

- Fix: Pass a function as the handler.
- Exceptions: Not reported when the type of the argument is unknown.

**`admin.event-bus.missing-handler`**

- Fix: Pass a handler function as the second argument of on().
- Exceptions: Only events declared in the typed EventBus event map are checked.

**`admin.event-bus.missing-payload`**

- Fix: Pass the payload the event declares as the second argument of emit().
- Exceptions: Only events declared in the typed EventBus event map are checked; events whose payload may be undefined need none.

**`admin.event-bus.payload-type`**

- Fix: Pass a payload of the type the event declares.
- Exceptions: Not reported when the type of the argument is unknown.

**`admin.shopware-context.unknown-member`**

- Fix: Correct the property name; a quick fix offers the close name.
- Exceptions: Reported only when a registered name is close to the one written; a name with no close match is taken for one added at runtime.

**`admin.shopware-utils.unknown-member`**

- Fix: Correct the helper name; a quick fix offers the close name.
- Exceptions: Reported only when a registered name is close to the one written; a name with no close match is taken for one added at runtime.

## `shopware.admin.migration`

Administration syntax to migrate: Twig components the Meteor component library replaces, once the project's Administration marks them deprecated or no longer registers them; deprecated slot syntax; and vue-i18n's `$tc`.

Languages: javascript, twig, vue. Domain: `administration`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `admin.slot-syntax-deprecated` | warning | yes |
| `admin.twig.migration.alert` | warning | yes |
| `admin.twig.migration.button` | warning | yes |
| `admin.twig.migration.card` | warning | yes |
| `admin.twig.migration.checkbox-field` | warning | yes |
| `admin.twig.migration.colorpicker` | warning | yes |
| `admin.twig.migration.datepicker` | warning | yes |
| `admin.twig.migration.email-field` | warning | yes |
| `admin.twig.migration.icon` | warning | yes |
| `admin.twig.migration.loader` | warning | yes |
| `admin.twig.migration.number-field` | warning | yes |
| `admin.twig.migration.password-field` | warning | yes |
| `admin.twig.migration.popover` | warning | yes |
| `admin.twig.migration.progress-bar` | warning | yes |
| `admin.twig.migration.select-field` | warning | yes |
| `admin.twig.migration.skeleton-bar` | warning | yes |
| `admin.twig.migration.switch-field` | warning | yes |
| `admin.twig.migration.text-field` | warning | yes |
| `admin.twig.migration.textarea-field` | warning | yes |
| `admin.twig.migration.url-field` | warning | yes |
| `admin.vue-i18n.tc-deprecated` | warning | yes |

**`admin.slot-syntax-deprecated`**

- Fix: Use <template #name="scope"> in place of slot and slot-scope; a quick fix rewrites the tag.
- Exceptions: slot on an element other than <template> is not reported.

**`admin.twig.migration.alert`**

- Fix: Replace sw-alert with mt-banner. The quick fix "Migrate sw-alert to mt-banner" renames the tag and rewrites props, events and slots when the usage converts mechanically; otherwise migrate by hand and review what the message names.
- Exceptions: Reported from Shopware 6.7, in .html.twig templates, once the project's Administration marks the component deprecated or no longer registers it. A usage with constructs that have no direct counterpart (a bound variant, conflicting attributes, complex label slots) is reported without a quick fix.

**`admin.vue-i18n.tc-deprecated`**

- Fix: Call $t() with the same arguments; it handles pluralization. A quick fix renames the call.

## `shopware.admin.module`

Administration references to modules, module routes and privileges that are not registered.

**`admin.module.not-found`**

## `shopware.dal.definition`

Entity classes that cannot hold a field of their entity definition: no property of that name, a private or readonly property, or a protected property without a getter or setter.

Languages: php. Domain: `shopware`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `shopware.dal.entity_property.getter_missing` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.dal.entity_property.missing` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.dal.entity_property.private` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.dal.entity_property.readonly` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.dal.entity_property.setter_missing` | warning | yes |

**`shopware.dal.entity_property.getter_missing`**

- Fix: Add a getter named get, is or has followed by the property name.

**`shopware.dal.entity_property.missing`**

- Fix: Add a property to the entity class with the name of the field (the second argument of most fields, the first of association fields), plus a getter and a setter.
- Exceptions: Definitions without their own getEntityClass() hydrate ArrayEntity and are not checked. Fields without a name argument (CustomFields, ReferenceVersionField, TranslationsAssociationField) are not checked.

**`shopware.dal.entity_property.private`**

- Fix: Make the property protected; the entity hydrator cannot write private properties.

**`shopware.dal.entity_property.readonly`**

- Fix: Remove readonly from the property; the DAL assigns it after constructing the entity.

**`shopware.dal.entity_property.setter_missing`**

- Fix: Add a setter named set followed by the property name.
- Exceptions: Fields flagged Runtime or Computed need no setter.

## `shopware.entity_snapshot`

Entity schema snapshots that no longer match the entity definitions or their migrations.

Languages: json. Domain: `shopware.entitySchema`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `shopware.entity_snapshot.graph` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.entity_snapshot.invalid` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.entity_snapshot.migration_changed` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.entity_snapshot.migration_missing` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.entity_snapshot.parent_missing` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.entity_snapshot.reconcile` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.entity_snapshot.schema_drift` | warning | yes |

**`shopware.entity_snapshot.graph`**

- Fix: Restore the snapshot files from version control; their parent links no longer form one history.

**`shopware.entity_snapshot.invalid`**

- Fix: Do not edit snapshot files by hand: restore the file from version control, or recreate it with the entity schema tools (shopware_entity_schema_preview and shopware_entity_schema_apply).

**`shopware.entity_snapshot.migration_changed`**

- Fix: Revert the change to the migration and put it into a new migration; a migration that has run on an installation is not run again.

**`shopware.entity_snapshot.migration_missing`**

- Fix: Restore the migration the snapshot references; a released migration must not be deleted.

**`shopware.entity_snapshot.parent_missing`**

- Fix: Restore the missing parent snapshots from version control; a snapshot may only be removed together with everything that follows it.

**`shopware.entity_snapshot.reconcile`**

- Fix: Two branches each added a snapshot. Reconcile them with the entity schema tool shopware_entity_schema_reconcile, which writes one snapshot following both.

**`shopware.entity_snapshot.schema_drift`**

- Fix: The entity definitions were changed without a snapshot and migration. Apply the change through the entity schema tools (shopware_entity_schema_load, _preview, _apply), which write both.

## `shopware.migration.announced`

Calls, property accesses and subclasses that stop working with a change the installed Shopware announces through its BCChange attributes: API becoming internal, final, abstract, readonly or less visible, parameters that are removed, renamed, added or narrowed, and return and property types that are widened.

Languages: php. Domain: `shopware.migrations`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `shopware.migration.announced.abstract` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.migration.announced.final` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.migration.announced.internal` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.migration.announced.parameter.removed` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.migration.announced.parameter.renamed` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.migration.announced.parameter.required` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.migration.announced.parameter.type` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.migration.announced.property.readonly` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.migration.announced.property.redeclared` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.migration.announced.property.type` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.migration.announced.type.widened` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.migration.announced.visibility` | warning | yes |

**`shopware.migration.announced.abstract`**

- Fix: Implement the method in the subclass now; an implementation is valid before and after the change.
- Exceptions: A subclass that inherits an implementation from a class in between is not reported.

**`shopware.migration.announced.final`**

- Fix: Stop extending the class; decorate the service or use its extension points. There is no declaration that works before and after the change.
- Opt out: Mark the subclass @deprecated tag:<version> when it is removed with the change.

**`shopware.migration.announced.internal`**

- Fix: Stop using the class or method before the version in the message: it leaves the public API then. Look for the replacement in its deprecation note or the upgrade guide.
- Exceptions: Code in the package that declares it, and code marked @deprecated tag:<version> for the same version, is not reported.
- Opt out: Mark the class or function that goes away with the change: @deprecated tag:<version>.

**`shopware.migration.announced.parameter.removed`**

- Fix: Stop passing the argument; the method ignores it from the version in the message.

**`shopware.migration.announced.parameter.renamed`**

- Fix: Pass the argument by position instead of by name: no name is valid before and after the change.

**`shopware.migration.announced.parameter.required`**

- Fix: Pass the new argument by position now, after the existing ones; Shopware already accepts it.
- Exceptions: Calls with a spread argument are not judged.

**`shopware.migration.announced.parameter.type`**

- Fix: Pass a value of the announced type.
- Exceptions: Only values that can never fit are reported: an int|string value for a parameter narrowed to int is not.

**`shopware.migration.announced.property.readonly`**

- Fix: Stop assigning the property from outside its class; pass the value to the constructor or use the method that sets it.

**`shopware.migration.announced.property.redeclared`**

- Fix: Remove the redeclaration and use the inherited property; no declaration is valid before and after the change.

**`shopware.migration.announced.property.type`**

- Fix: Assign a value of the announced type.
- Exceptions: Only values that can never fit are reported.

**`shopware.migration.announced.type.widened`**

- Fix: Handle the announced type where the value is used: check for null before dereferencing or passing it on, or use ?->.
- Exceptions: A use that already accepts the wider type is not reported, nor one after a check such as !== null.

**`shopware.migration.announced.visibility`**

- Fix: Stop calling the method or reading the property from outside the scope it will be visible in.
- Exceptions: Access from a scope that stays allowed (the class itself, or a subclass for protected) is not reported.

## `shopware.migration.api`

Shopware API that the upgrade to the target version renames or removes: classes (including the moves the installed Shopware announces), methods, static methods, constants, properties and exception factories, with automated fixes where the change is safe.

Languages: php. Domain: `shopware.migrations`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `shopware.migration.api.class.rename` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.migration.api.constant.rename` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.migration.api.exception_factory` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.migration.api.method.rename` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.migration.api.property` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.migration.api.static_method.rename` | warning | yes |

**`shopware.migration.api.class.rename`**

- Fix: Use the new class name; the quick fix "Rename class" rewrites the use statement and the references.
- Exceptions: Short-name uses of an imported class are not reported separately, only the import. A grouped use statement is reported without a quick fix.

**`shopware.migration.api.constant.rename`**

- Fix: Read the constant from the class the message names; a quick fix moves the reference.
- Exceptions: Reported only when the Shopware target version is known (shopware.targetVersion, or shopware/core in composer.lock) and has reached the version in the message.

**`shopware.migration.api.exception_factory`**

- Fix: Create the exception through the static factory the message names; a quick fix replaces the `new` expression.
- Exceptions: Reported only when the Shopware target version is known (shopware.targetVersion, or shopware/core in composer.lock) and has reached the version in the message.

**`shopware.migration.api.method.rename`**

- Fix: Call the new method name; a quick fix renames the call.
- Exceptions: Reported only when the Shopware target version is known (shopware.targetVersion, or shopware/core in composer.lock) and has reached the version in the message.

**`shopware.migration.api.property`**

- Fix: Call the getter the message names in place of reading the property; a quick fix does it.
- Exceptions: An assignment to the property is reported without a quick fix.

**`shopware.migration.api.static_method.rename`**

- Fix: Call the replacement the message names; a quick fix rewrites the call.
- Exceptions: Reported only when the Shopware target version is known (shopware.targetVersion, or shopware/core in composer.lock) and has reached the version in the message.

**`shopware.migration.annotation.route_defaults`**

**`shopware.migration.cart_behavior.permission`**

**`shopware.migration.context_metadata.state`**

- Fix: Set the indexing flag with $context->addState(); a quick fix rewrites the call.
- Exceptions: Reported only when the Shopware target version is known (shopware.targetVersion, or shopware/core in composer.lock) and has reached the version in the message.

**`shopware.migration.entity_extension.entity_name`**

- Fix: Implement getEntityName() returning the entity name (Definition::ENTITY_NAME) and, from 6.7, remove getDefinitionClass(); a quick fix does it when the definition class can be read from getDefinitionClass().

**`shopware.migration.entity_search_result.get_entities`**

- Fix: Call the collection method on $result->getEntities(), and iterate or count getEntities(); a quick fix inserts the call.
- Exceptions: Reported from Shopware 6.8 on, and before that for the methods the installed EntitySearchResult marks as deprecated.

**`shopware.migration.faker.property_call`**

- Fix: Call the Faker formatter as a method ($faker->name()); a quick fix adds the parentheses.

**`shopware.migration.message_handler.subscriber`**

- Fix: Replace AbstractMessageHandler with a handler class marked #[AsMessageHandler] whose __invoke() takes the message; a quick fix converts the class.

**`shopware.migration.price_definition.filterable`**

**`shopware.migration.product_stream.enrich_criteria`**

- Fix: Call $builder->enrichCriteria($criteria, ...) in place of adding the result of buildFilters(); a quick fix rewrites the common patterns and marks the others with a TODO comment.
- Exceptions: Reported only when the Shopware target version is known (shopware.targetVersion, or shopware/core in composer.lock) and has reached the version in the message.

**`shopware.migration.reflection_helper.native`**

- Fix: Use PHP's ReflectionMethod, ReflectionProperty or ReflectionClass directly; a quick fix rewrites the call.
- Exceptions: Calls with named or spread arguments are reported without a quick fix.

**`shopware.migration.reverse_proxy.ban_all`**

- Fix: Implement banAll() on the gateway; a quick fix adds an implementation that bans everything.

**`shopware.migration.scheduled_task.exception_logger`**

- Fix: Take a Psr\Log\LoggerInterface in the constructor and pass it as the second argument of parent::__construct(); a quick fix does both.
- Exceptions: Handlers without a constructor of their own are not reported.

## `shopware.migration.signature`

Declarations and calls whose signature changes with the upgrade to the target version: interfaces replaced by abstract classes, added or removed parameters and arguments, and changed native types, including the changes the installed Shopware announces through its BCChange attributes.

**`shopware.migration.declaration.type`**

## `shopware.php.local`

Store review rules checkable in one file: disallowed functions, superglobals, session functions, insecure cookies, disabled TLS verification, weak crypto and disabled foreign key checks.

Languages: php. Domain: `shopware`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `shopware.php.cookie.insecure` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.crypto.predictable_salt` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.crypto.weak_key` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.foreign_key_checks.disabled` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.function.disallowed` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.glob_brace` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.session.function` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.superglobal` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.tls.verification_disabled` | warning | yes |

**`shopware.php.cookie.insecure`**

- Fix: Pass secure: true (the sixth argument, or the `secure` key of the options array).
- Exceptions: A call whose options come from a variable is not reported.

**`shopware.php.crypto.predictable_salt`**

- Fix: Do not pass a salt: password_hash() generates one. Replace crypt() with password_hash().
- Exceptions: A salt that is not a string literal is not reported.

**`shopware.php.crypto.weak_key`**

- Fix: Use at least 2048 bits for RSA keys.
- Exceptions: Only a literal private_key_bits value is judged.

**`shopware.php.foreign_key_checks.disabled`**

- Fix: Leave FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS alone in a migration or plugin update: delete or migrate rows in dependency order, children before parents.
- Exceptions: Only strings inside update() of a MigrationStep or Plugin subclass are reported; updateDestructive() is not.

**`shopware.php.function.disallowed`**

- Fix: Remove the call. For diagnostics use a PSR logger; to stop a request throw an exception or return a response.
- Exceptions: Methods and namespaced functions with the same name are not reported.

**`shopware.php.glob_brace`**

- Fix: Call glob() once per alternative and merge the results; GLOB_BRACE does not exist on every platform (Alpine/musl).

**`shopware.php.session.function`**

- Fix: Use the session of the request: $request->getSession().

**`shopware.php.superglobal`**

- Fix: Read the value from the Symfony Request the controller or subscriber receives ($request->query, $request->request, $request->files).
- Exceptions: $_SERVER, $_ENV, $_COOKIE and $_SESSION are not reported.

**`shopware.php.tls.verification_disabled`**

- Fix: Keep certificate and host verification on. For a private CA configure its certificate (CURLOPT_CAINFO, the `cafile` stream option) instead of disabling the check.
- Exceptions: Only literal option values are judged; a value from a variable is not reported.

## `shopware.php.semantic`

Store review rules needing type information: internal API use, repositories queried in loops, session access in Store API routes and payment handlers, scheduled task intervals, default contexts, system config reads ignoring the sales channel, kernel listeners checking the route, insecure Symfony cookies, empty responses, writes to the local disk, unrestricted searches, config reads in constructors, translated state names, entities in queue messages, GET routes that change data, Admin API write routes without privileges, getcwd(), debug output and empty catch blocks.

Languages: php. Domain: `shopware`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `shopware.php.catch.empty` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.context.default` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.cookie.symfony_insecure` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.decorator.concrete_extension` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.filesystem.getcwd` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.filesystem.local_write` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.function.debug_output` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.internal.class_extension` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.internal.function_call` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.internal.method_call` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.listener.route_condition` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.message.entity_payload` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.repository.in_loop` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.repository.unbounded_search` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.response.empty` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.route.acl_missing` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.route.get_mutation` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.scheduled_task.interval` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.session.constructor` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.session.payment_handler` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.session.store_api` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.state.translated_name` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.system_config.constructor` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.system_config.sales_channel` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.php.user.store_token` | warning | yes |

**`shopware.php.catch.empty`**

- Fix: Handle the failure, log it, or rethrow. When ignoring it is right, catch the specific exception.
- Exceptions: A catch of a specific exception class is not reported.
- Opt out: Put a comment in the block that says why the failure can be ignored.

**`shopware.php.context.default`**

- Fix: Use the Context the caller already has: controllers and subscribers receive one, and services should take it as a parameter. In console commands and scheduled tasks use Context::createCLIContext().
- Exceptions: Not reported when the installed Shopware has no Context::createCLIContext() yet. Tests may create a default context; suppress it there or switch the rule off for the test directory.

**`shopware.php.cookie.symfony_insecure`**

- Fix: Pass secure: true to new Cookie() or Cookie::create(), or chain ->withSecure().
- Exceptions: A creation followed by ->withSecure() or ->withSecure(true) in the same chain is not reported.

**`shopware.php.decorator.concrete_extension`**

- Fix: Extend the abstract class named in the message and implement getDecorated(), so other decorators of the same service keep working.

**`shopware.php.filesystem.getcwd`**

- Fix: Inject the %kernel.project_dir% parameter and build the path from it.

**`shopware.php.filesystem.local_write`**

- Fix: Write through a Flysystem filesystem service (shopware.filesystem.private or .public), which also works with remote storage and several app servers. For a temporary file build the path from sys_get_temp_dir().
- Exceptions: A path that mentions sys_get_temp_dir(), tempnam(), or a name containing temp or tmp, and the standard streams, are not reported. Console commands that generate files into the project (scaffolding) are a legitimate reason to suppress the finding.

**`shopware.php.function.debug_output`**

- Fix: Remove the call, or log the value. To format a value into a string pass true as the second argument of print_r() or var_export().
- Exceptions: print_r($value, true) and var_export($value, true) return a string and are not reported.

**`shopware.php.internal.class_extension`**

- Fix: Do not extend the class. Decorate the service through its abstract class or interface, or subscribe to the events it dispatches.

**`shopware.php.internal.function_call`**

- Fix: Use the public API instead; internal functions change without notice.
- Exceptions: Calls from the package that declares the function are not reported.

**`shopware.php.internal.method_call`**

- Fix: Call the public API that wraps the method; internal methods change without notice between minor versions.
- Exceptions: Calls from the package that declares the method, and from the Shopware namespace itself, are not reported.

**`shopware.php.listener.route_condition`**

- Fix: Subscribe to the event Shopware dispatches for that route, named in the message (for example frontend.home.page.request), and drop the route check.
- Exceptions: A listener that compares the route with === (acts on one route but does not return for the others) is not reported.

**`shopware.php.message.entity_payload`**

- Fix: Put the ID in the message and load the entity in the handler. For a sales channel context carry the sales channel ID and the context token, or the values the handler needs.
- Exceptions: Only properties and constructor parameters of AsyncMessageInterface messages are checked. A Context is not reported.

**`shopware.php.repository.in_loop`**

- Fix: Collect the IDs first and run one search or one write with all of them outside the loop; for writes pass all payloads to a single upsert().
- Exceptions: The expression a foreach iterates over and the initializer of a for loop run once and are not reported.

**`shopware.php.repository.unbounded_search`**

- Fix: Restrict the Criteria: pass IDs, add a filter or setLimit(), or iterate with RepositoryIterator. When only IDs or a count are needed use searchIds() or an aggregation.
- Exceptions: searchIds(), a Criteria created with IDs, one that had any method called on it or was passed to another function, and one received as a parameter are not reported. Loading a small fixed table in full (languages, currencies) is a legitimate reason to suppress the finding.

**`shopware.php.response.empty`**

- Fix: Return content, or state that there is none: new Response(null, Response::HTTP_NO_CONTENT), or a JsonResponse with data.
- Exceptions: Status codes 204, 301, 302, 303, 304, 307 and 308 need no body. Arguments passed through a spread are not judged.

**`shopware.php.route.acl_missing`**

- Fix: Add the privileges the action needs to the route: defaults: ['_acl' => ['my_entity:update']]. Use privileges that exist; the Administration role must grant them.
- Exceptions: Routes with an _acl default on the method or the class, routes without a methods list, GET-only routes, and routes outside the api route scope are not reported. A missing _acl is not proof of a missing check: writes through a repository with the caller's context are checked by the DAL.
- Opt out: Declare that the route needs no privilege of its own with an empty list: defaults: ['_acl' => []]. Shopware treats it like no _acl.

**`shopware.php.route.get_mutation`**

- Fix: Move the write into a route that accepts POST, PATCH or DELETE. For a link sent by mail, let the GET route show a confirmation page whose form posts the change.
- Exceptions: create() is not reported (logging a visit), nor are routes that also accept another method.

**`shopware.php.scheduled_task.interval`**

- Fix: Return at least 300 seconds from getDefaultInterval(). For work that must run more often dispatch a message when the triggering event happens.
- Exceptions: Only a literal return value is judged.

**`shopware.php.session.constructor`**

- Fix: Read the session in the method that needs it; a constructor runs when the service is built, possibly before a request exists, and starts the session for every request.

**`shopware.php.session.payment_handler`**

- Fix: Carry the state in the order transaction (custom fields) or in the request data bag; payment handlers also run without a storefront session (Store API, headless).

**`shopware.php.session.store_api`**

- Fix: Store API routes are stateless: take the value from the request or the SalesChannelContext, and keep state in the cart or the customer.

**`shopware.php.state.translated_name`**

- Fix: Compare getTechnicalName() with the technical name of the state (for example OrderTransactionStates::STATE_PAID).
- Exceptions: Printing the name and comparing two names with each other are not reported.

**`shopware.php.system_config.constructor`**

- Fix: Keep the SystemConfigService in a property and read the value in the method that uses it, with the sales channel ID of the current context.

**`shopware.php.system_config.sales_channel`**

- Fix: Pass $context->getSalesChannelId() as the second argument, so a value overridden for the sales channel is used.
- Exceptions: Reported only inside a function that has a SalesChannelContext parameter. A string variable as the second argument is accepted.

**`shopware.php.user.store_token`**

- Fix: Do not read the store token of an administration user; it is the merchant's credential for the Shopware Store.

## `shopware.snippet`

Storefront and Administration snippet keys no snippet file defines.

Languages: javascript, twig. Domain: `shopware.snippets`.

| `admin.snippet.missing` | warning | yes |
| `frontend.snippet.missing` | warning | yes |

**`admin.snippet.missing`**

- Fix: Add the key to an Administration snippet file of the extension; the quick fix "Create admin snippet" does it. Or correct the key.
- Exceptions: Keys built at runtime are not checked, nor are module titles and descriptions that contain spaces (plain text).

**`frontend.snippet.missing`**

- Fix: Add the key to a storefront snippet file of the extension (Resources/snippet/**/*.json); the quick fix "Create snippet" does it. Or correct the key.

## `shopware.snippet_files`

Snippet files that differ from the main language file (en.json, else en-GB.json) in the same directory: missing keys, keys the main file does not define, and values of another type.

Languages: json. Domain: `shopware.snippets`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `shopware.snippet.file.missing-key` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.snippet.file.type-mismatch` | warning | yes |
| `shopware.snippet.file.unknown-key` | warning | yes |

**`shopware.snippet.file.missing-key`**

- Fix: Add the named keys with their translation; the main language file (the sibling with the same stem in en, else en-GB: storefront.en-GB.json for storefront.de-DE.json) defines them.
- Exceptions: A file without a main language file beside it, or without a locale in its name, is not compared.

**`shopware.snippet.file.type-mismatch`**

- Fix: Give the key the same shape as in the main language file: a text where it has a text, an object where it has nested keys.
- Exceptions: A file without a main language file beside it, or without a locale in its name, is not compared.

**`shopware.snippet.file.unknown-key`**

- Fix: Remove the key, or add it to the main language file when the snippet is used.
- Exceptions: A file without a main language file beside it, or without a locale in its name, is not compared.

## `shopware.twig_versioning`

Storefront block overrides whose `shopware-block` version comment is missing, outdated or unmatched, and overrides of deprecated or unchanged blocks. Opt-in.

Languages: twig. Domain: `shopware.twigVersioning`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `twig.block.deprecated` | warning | yes |
| `twig.block.redundant_override` | hint | yes |
| `twig.versioning.comment_missing` | warning | no |
| `twig.versioning.original_missing` | warning | yes |
| `twig.versioning.outdated` | warning | yes |

**`twig.block.deprecated`**

- Fix: Override the block the upstream deprecation note names instead; the deprecated block is removed with the version in the note.

**`twig.block.redundant_override`**

- Fix: The block repeats its parent unchanged: remove the override, or replace its body with {{ parent() }}; a quick fix does the latter.

**`twig.versioning.comment_missing`**

- Fix: Add a {# shopware-block: <hash>@<version> #} comment that records which upstream block the override was written against; a quick fix adds it.
- Exceptions: Off by default. Blocks that only delegate to parent() need no comment.

**`twig.versioning.original_missing`**

- Fix: The upstream block is gone or moved. Find where the content lives now and move the override there, or delete it.
- Exceptions: Blocks without a versioning comment are not reported.

**`twig.versioning.outdated`**

- Fix: The upstream block changed since the override was written. Compare the upstream block, carry the change over where needed, then update the comment; quick fixes show the diff and update the comment.

## `symfony.service`

References to services, parameters and classes that do not exist or are deprecated.

Languages: php, xml, yaml. Domain: `symfony.services`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `symfony.class.deprecated` | warning | yes |

| `symfony.service.deprecated` | warning | yes |
| `symfony.service.missing` | warning | yes |

**`symfony.class.deprecated`**

- Fix: Use the replacement the class's @deprecated note names.

**`symfony.class.missing`**

- Fix: Correct the class name; a quick fix offers close names.

**`symfony.parameter.missing`**

- Fix: Use the name of an existing parameter; a quick fix offers close names.
- Exceptions: Missing services and parameters are judged only against a compiled container (var/cache/*/…DebugContainer.xml): without one nothing is reported. Run bin/console cache:warmup once.
- Opt out: A getParameter('name') guarded by hasParameter('name') in the same file is not reported.

**`symfony.service.deprecated`**

- Fix: Use the replacement the deprecation message names.

**`symfony.service.missing`**

- Fix: Use the ID of an existing service; a quick fix offers close names. A service of the extension must be defined in its services configuration.
- Exceptions: Missing services and parameters are judged only against a compiled container (var/cache/*/…DebugContainer.xml): without one nothing is reported. Run bin/console cache:warmup once.
- Opt out: Mark an optional reference: `@?id` in YAML, on-invalid="null" in XML, ->nullOnInvalid() in PHP configuration. A get('id') guarded by has('id') in the same file is not reported either.

## `symfony.service.arguments`

Service definitions missing constructor arguments, passing arguments of the wrong type, naming unknown arguments, or calling methods that do not exist.

Languages: php, xml, yaml. Domain: `symfony.services`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `symfony.service.argument.type` | warning | yes |
| `symfony.service.arguments.missing` | warning | yes |
| `symfony.service.method.missing` | warning | yes |
| `symfony.service.named_argument.unknown` | warning | yes |

**`symfony.service.argument.type`**

- Fix: Pass a service whose class is the type the parameter expects; a quick fix offers compatible services.
- Exceptions: Parameters without an object type are not checked.

**`symfony.service.arguments.missing`**

- Fix: Add the missing constructor arguments, or enable autowiring for the service; a quick fix adds them, using the service of the matching type where there is exactly one.
- Exceptions: Autowired, abstract, aliased and factory-built services, and services with a parent, are not checked.

**`symfony.service.method.missing`**

- Fix: Add the method to the service class or correct its name; quick fixes create the method or offer close names.

**`symfony.service.named_argument.unknown`**

- Fix: Use the name of a constructor parameter ($name); a quick fix offers them.
- Exceptions: Services built by a factory are not checked.

## `symfony.service.tag_type`

Tagged services that do not implement the interface their tag requires.

Languages: xml, yaml. Domain: `symfony.services`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `symfony.service.tag_type` | warning | yes |

**`symfony.service.tag_type`**

- Fix: Make the class implement the interface, or extend the base class, the tag requires; or remove the tag.
- Exceptions: Tags without a known contract are not checked.

## `symfony.services_xml_migration`

XML service and route configuration, deprecated in favor of YAML or PHP, with an automated conversion: the services.xml and routes.xml loaded by convention, and XML files a services.php or routes.php imports.

Languages: xml, php. Domain: `symfony.services`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `symfony.routes_xml.deprecated` | warning | yes |
| `symfony.services_xml.deprecated` | warning | yes |

**`symfony.routes_xml.deprecated`**

- Fix: Convert the XML route configuration to YAML. A quick fix converts Resources/config/routes.xml and the route files it imports; for an XML file imported from Resources/config/routes.php a quick fix converts it and points the import() call at the YAML file.
- Exceptions: Reported for Resources/config/routes.xml and for import('file.xml') calls in Resources/config/routes.php. Imports with a glob, a bundle path or a path built at runtime, and XML loaded from elsewhere, are not reported. A file with an element or attribute the conversion does not know is reported without a quick fix.

**`symfony.services_xml.deprecated`**

- Fix: Convert the XML service configuration to YAML. A quick fix converts Resources/config/services.xml and the XML files it imports; for an XML file imported from Resources/config/services.php a quick fix converts it and points the import() call at the YAML file. A file with a construct YAML cannot express (on-invalid="null" in a method call, a property or a collection) has to be changed first.
- Exceptions: Reported for Resources/config/services.xml and for import('file.xml') calls in Resources/config/services.php. Imports with a glob, a bundle path or a path built at runtime, and XML loaded from elsewhere, are not reported.

## `symfony.translation`

Translation keys and domains no translation file defines, with a fix adding the key.

Languages: php, twig. Domain: `symfony`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `symfony.translation.domain.missing` | warning | yes |
| `symfony.translation.key.missing` | warning | yes |

**`symfony.translation.domain.missing`**

- Fix: Use an existing translation domain; a quick fix offers close names.

**`symfony.translation.key.missing`**

- Fix: Add the key to a translation file of the domain; quick fixes add it to an existing catalogue or offer close keys.
- Exceptions: Keys built at runtime are not checked. In the messages domain a Shopware storefront snippet with the key counts; in the validators domain a storefront snippet with the key or with `error.<key>` counts, as the storefront shows violations. A validator message written as a sentence (with spaces) is shown as it is and not reported.

## `twig.component`

Twig component usages naming unknown components, blocks, live actions or arguments, and mixed component syntax.

Languages: twig. Domain: `symfony.twigComponents`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `twig.component.block.missing` | warning | yes |
| `twig.component.live_action.missing` | warning | yes |
| `twig.component.live_argument.missing` | warning | yes |
| `twig.component.missing` | warning | yes |
| `twig.component.mixed_syntax` | warning | yes |
| `twig.component.self_macro_import` | warning | yes |

**`twig.component.block.missing`**

- Fix: Use a block the component's template defines; a quick fix offers close names.

**`twig.component.live_action.missing`**

- Fix: Use an action the live component declares with #[LiveAction]; a quick fix offers close names.

**`twig.component.live_argument.missing`**

- Fix: Use a parameter name of the live action; a quick fix offers close names.

**`twig.component.missing`**

- Fix: Use the name of a registered Twig component; a quick fix offers close names.

**`twig.component.mixed_syntax`**

- Fix: Inside <twig:Component> write <twig:block name="..."> in place of {% block %}.
- Exceptions: {% block %} inside the {% component %} tag syntax is valid and not reported.

**`twig.component.self_macro_import`**

- Fix: Import the macros by the template's full path; _self refers to the component's template inside a component.

**`twig.component.live_event_argument.missing`**

- Fix: Use an argument the listener declares with #[LiveArg]; a quick fix offers close names.

Macro calls naming macros the imported template does not define.

## `twig.markup`

Storefront templates printing unescaped or wrongly escaped output (raw or sw_sanitize in an attribute, raw after trans), and HTML that needs an attribute it lacks: links opening a new window, buttons without a type, images without alt text, and attributes written twice.

Languages: twig. Domain: `twig`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `twig.html.button_type` | warning | yes |
| `twig.html.duplicate_attribute` | warning | yes |
| `twig.html.img_alt` | warning | yes |
| `twig.html.target_blank` | warning | yes |
| `twig.raw.attribute` | warning | yes |
| `twig.raw.translation` | warning | yes |
| `twig.sanitize.attribute` | warning | yes |

**`twig.html.button_type`**

- Fix: Add type="button" for a button that runs a script, type="submit" for one that submits its form.
- Exceptions: A tag with Twig between its attributes is not judged; it may add the type.

**`twig.html.duplicate_attribute`**

- Fix: Remove one of the two; browsers ignore the second. Merge class values into one attribute.
- Exceptions: Attributes in different branches of an if are not duplicates.

**`twig.html.img_alt`**

- Fix: Add alt text that says what the image shows, from a snippet; use alt="" for a decorative image.
- Exceptions: A tag with Twig between its attributes is not judged.

**`twig.html.target_blank`**

- Fix: Add rel="noopener" to the link (rel="noopener noreferrer" to also hide the referrer).
- Exceptions: A rel or target built with Twig is not judged.

**`twig.raw.attribute`**

- Fix: Remove |raw so Twig escapes the value, or use |escape('html_attr') for a value that is not quoted. For JSON in an attribute use |json_encode without raw.
- Exceptions: raw in element content is not reported.

**`twig.raw.translation`**

- Fix: Replace |raw with |sw_sanitize: it keeps the allowed formatting of the snippet and removes scripts.
- Exceptions: json_encode|raw and raw on a plain variable are not reported.

**`twig.sanitize.attribute`**

- Fix: Remove |sw_sanitize so Twig escapes the value; to drop markup from the text use |striptags.
- Exceptions: sw_sanitize in element content is not reported.

## `twig.member.call`

PHP method calls from Twig whose arguments match no method of the variable's type.

Languages: twig. Domain: `twig`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `twig.member.arguments` | warning | yes |
| `twig.member.not-callable` | warning | yes |

**`twig.member.arguments`**

- Fix: Pass the arguments the PHP method expects; the message names the mismatch.
- Exceptions: Arguments of unknown type match anything. Calls with named or spread arguments, and classes with __call, are not checked.

**`twig.member.not-callable`**

- Fix: Drop the parentheses to read the property, or call a method that exists: with parentheses Twig only calls methods.

## `twig.member.deprecation`

Twig member access to deprecated properties and methods.

Languages: twig. Domain: `twig`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `twig.member.deprecated` | warning | yes |

**`twig.member.deprecated`**

- Fix: Use the member the @deprecated note of the PHP declaration names.

## `twig.member.missing`

Twig member access to properties and methods the variable's type does not have.

Languages: twig. Domain: `twig`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `twig.member.missing` | warning | yes |

**`twig.member.missing`**

- Fix: Use a property or method the PHP class has (Twig also tries getX(), isX() and hasX()), or correct the declared type of the variable.
- Exceptions: Reported only for a variable with a definite object type. Arrays, values of unknown type, ArrayAccess and Traversable objects, stdClass and classes with __get or __call are not checked; neither is a member a known subclass of the type has, nor any member when a known subclass has array or magic access.

## `twig.member.nullable`

Twig member access on a value that can be null, where no condition around it rules null out: an error under strict_variables. Opt-in.

Languages: twig. Domain: `twig`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `twig.member.null` | warning | no |

**`twig.member.null`**

- Fix: Rule null out before the access: wrap it in {% if value %}, use the null-safe accessor (value?.member, Twig 3.23), or give a fallback with ?? or |default.
- Exceptions: Off by default: Twig yields null for an attribute of null unless strict_variables is on. Accesses inside `is defined`, the left side of ??, the input of |default and a ?. chain are not reported; neither are values of unknown type.
- Opt out: Leave the rule disabled when the project does not run with strict_variables.

Rendering a block the template does not define.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `twig.template.block.missing` | warning | yes |

**`twig.template.block.missing`**

## `twig.template`

References to templates that do not exist, and PHP render calls for templates marked abstract.

Languages: php, twig. Domain: `twig`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `twig.template.abstract` | error | yes |
| `twig.template.missing` | error | yes |

**`twig.template.abstract`**

- Fix: Render a template that extends the abstract one, or remove the {# @twigstan-abstract #} comment when the template is meant to be rendered.
- Exceptions: Only PHP render calls are checked; extending, including and embedding an abstract template is allowed.

**`twig.template.missing`**

- Fix: Correct the template name, or create the template; quick fixes offer close names and, for a name below templates/, create the file.
- Exceptions: Names built at runtime, and includes marked `ignore missing`, are not checked.
- Opt out: Add `ignore missing` to an include whose template is optional.

## `twig.variable`

Twig variables no render call, including or extending template, assignment or global provides. Opt-in.

Languages: twig. Domain: `twig`.

| Code | Default severity | Enabled by default |
|---|---|---|
| `twig.variable.undefined` | warning | no |

**`twig.variable.undefined`**

- Fix: Pass the variable from the render call or the including template, assign it with {% set %}, or declare an optional one with {% types { name?: 'type' } %} and test it with `is defined`.
- Exceptions: Off by default. Reported only when a PHP render call passes variables to the template or to one that includes or extends it. Variables added at render time by event listeners or extensions are not seen; templates rendered with a context held in a variable, and templates used by too many others, are not checked.
- Opt out: Declare a variable the analysis cannot see with {# @var name type #} or {% types { name: 'type' } %}.
